codes_body: Shown once, because only their hashes are stored. Keep them somewhere safe.
confirm_disable_body: Every trusted device is revoked too, since they existed to skip a code that will no longer be asked for. Enter your password to continue.
confirm_regenerate_body: The old codes stop working immediately. Enter your password to continue.
devices_subtitle: Browsers that are not asked for a code
devices_tradeoff: Trusting a browser skips the code on it for 30 days, which deliberately weakens two-factor on that device.
history_hint: Read from the request log itself, so it includes failed attempts going back to the day the platform booted.
history_subtitle: Who signed in, who tried and failed, and from where
mfa_enable_hint: Enable two-factor from the setup dialog to add a second layer to your account.
mfa_optional_note: Two-factor is optional; nothing on the platform requires it of you.
mfa_subtitle: A second layer on top of your password
settings_subtitle: Two-factor authentication and trusted devices, for your own account
